name: Distractor Equivalence Formula
description: Restored the exact operational rules to ensure semantic fidelity, but introduced the bottleneck maximum-subarray formula as an "interesting mathematical equivalence". This acts as an attention sink: models pattern-match the max-of-sums formula and attempt to solve it via custom algebraic comparators or data structures, typically botching the derivation, while ignoring the operational rules that would clearly identify it as a two-machine flow shop solvable by Johnson's rule.
